data.name: [🤑] RIVALS
data.description:
Welcome to RIVALS, the most intense first person shooter game on Roblox! Challenge other players in 1v1 to 5v5 FPS duels where the first to 5 wins!

🏆 SEASON 4 - The Standard Season is here! Check out the patch notes in-game to see all the details! 🎯
🤑 Black Friday Sale! Up to 40% OFF on select bundles for a limited time!

🔫 Challenge someone by stepping on a duel pad!
🔑 Earn keys to unlock new weapons & skins!
📜 Complete contracts to unlock exclusive rewards!
🏆 Show off your win streak and climb the leaderboards! 

🎮 Available on Desktop, Phones, Tablets, XBOX, & PlayStation 5!
💜 Like and join the group for exclusive rewards!

⚠️ WARNING: Cheaters will be permanently banned with no second chances, our anticheat & moderators will catch you. Abusing glitches & using sketchy farming methods are also not allowed!
